title: Parkio Daily for November 22, 2026
teaser: Living with the Land holiday overlay extended into January; Lightning Lane sold out at three parks ahead of Thanksgiving; Victoria & Albert's ranks top 10 nationwide.

rides.name: Living with the Land
rides.note: Glimmering Greenhouses soft-opened for the holiday season

rides.name: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad
rides.note: Lightning Lane availability tight through weekend

bignews.title: Living with the Land holiday overlay extended through January 2027
bignews.body: Glimmering Greenhouses, the festive transformation of EPCOT's 32-year-old boat ride, has soft-opened and will now run past the typical Festival of the Holidays end date into the new year. The overlay adds themed decorations and lighting throughout the attraction's greenhouse scenes.

parkioInsight.text: The extended run means you can skip the holiday crush and visit in early January when EPCOT crowds typically drop. Rope-drop visits to The Land pavilion usually offer walk-on windows through mid-morning.

bignews.title: Lightning Lane passes sold out at three Walt Disney World parks for Thanksgiving
bignews.body: Magic Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom exhausted their Lightning Lane inventory ahead of the busy holiday week, leaving only EPCOT with skip-the-line availability. The sellouts suggest heavier-than-expected attendance forecasts through the weekend.

parkioInsight.text: EPCOT is likely your best bet for manageable waits through Sunday. Test Track and Frozen Ever After typically see standby dips during World Showcase dinner hours, often between 6–8pm.

bignews.title: Victoria & Albert's earns top-10 U.S. restaurant ranking and AAA Four Diamond
bignews.body: The Grand Floridian's flagship dining room landed among the nation's top ten restaurants in new rankings, while Jiko at Animal Kingdom Lodge regained its AAA Four Diamond designation. Both restaurants join the trio of Walt Disney World locations that earned Michelin recognition last month.

parkioInsight.text: Reservations for both restaurants tend to open up 2–3 weeks out as plans shift. Check daily at 6am Eastern for same-day cancellations, which often appear for weeknight seatings.

bignews.title: EPCOT Festival of the Arts 2027 dates and artist lineup announced
bignews.body: The festival returns January 15 through March 1, 2027, featuring visual, culinary, and performing arts. Disney revealed both returning and new artists will participate, with the event presented by Disney Lorcana Trading Card Game.

parkioInsight.text: Opening weekend typically draws lighter crowds than Festival of the Holidays closings. Mid-week visits in late January usually offer the shortest waits for both attractions and food studio lines.

topstories.title: Tower of Terror implements new guest flow procedure at Hollywood Studios
topstories.body: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror has adjusted how guests move through the attraction queue and boarding process. The operational change affects how cast members direct visitors through the 1994 drop tower experience.

parkioInsight.text: Tower of Terror wait times often drop sharply after 7pm when families with young children exit the park. Single rider line, when available, typically moves 40–50% faster than standby.

topstories.title: Sam's Club offers discounted Disney gift cards ahead of Black Friday
topstories.body: The warehouse retailer is selling two-hundred-dollar Disney gift card packages at a discount as part of Black Friday promotions. The cards work at both domestic Disney theme park resorts and can stack with other payment methods.

parkioInsight.text: Gift cards purchased now can cover spring trip deposits or in-park spending. Mobile order purchases and merchandise tend to process faster when gift cards are already loaded into your My Disney Experience account before arrival.

topstories.title: Santa's sleigh and illuminated trees installed at Disneyland Hotel
topstories.body: New holiday decorations featuring a blue-and-white sleigh surrounded by lit white Christmas trees have arrived at the Disneyland Resort hotel. The display adds to the property's seasonal theming for the 2026 holidays.

parkioInsight.text: Hotel lobby decorations are typically less crowded for photos before 10am or after 9pm. The display is accessible to all guests, not just hotel visitors, via the main entrance.

topstories.title: Gingerbread displays return to resort hotels with scaled-back approach
topstories.body: Walt Disney World brought back holiday gingerbread creations across its resort hotels this week, though the company retired the Grand Floridian's signature house and introduced new restrictions on guest access to some displays. The change marks a shift from previous years' larger installations.

parkioInsight.text: Resort hotel lobbies tend to see peak congestion between 4–6pm as guests check in and daytrippers arrive for dinner reservations. Visiting gingerbread displays before 11am or after 8pm usually means easier photo opportunities.

topstories.title: Disney Storytime read-along series launches on Disney+ December 2
topstories.body: A new streaming series featuring characters from Disney, Pixar, and Disney Junior will debut next month. The read-along format is designed for family viewing and storytime experiences at home.

parkioInsight.text: Pre-trip viewing with young children may help build excitement and familiarity with park characters. Episodes tend to run short, making them useful for downtime during resort pool breaks or evening wind-down.

topstories.title: Frontierland medallion machine debuts at Disneyland's Pioneer Mercantile
topstories.body: A new pressed-coin machine offering four colorful Frontierland designs is now operating inside the themed shop. Single medallions cost ten dollars or all four for thirty-five dollars.

parkioInsight.text: Medallion machines often develop lines during mid-afternoon peak shopping hours. Stopping by Pioneer Mercantile during parade times or just before park closing typically means shorter waits.

topstories.title: Hallmark's Walt Disney World Christmas movie filmed with Make-A-Wish teen
topstories.body: Holiday Ever After, the network's first film set at the resort, features fourteen-year-old wish recipient Ceci, a Hallmark superfan who wanted to appear in a movie. The production wrapped at multiple Walt Disney World locations during her wish experience.

parkioInsight.text: The film's November 30 Disney+ premiere may spotlight lesser-known resort photo locations. Scenes filmed at featured spots often see brief upticks in guest interest for 2–3 weeks after release.

icymi.title: Teacup Confessions interview series launches with celebrities at Disney parks
icymi.body: Disney debuted a new video format in which celebrities are interviewed while riding the Mad Tea Party spinning teacup attraction. The series covers their current projects and Disney Parks memories.

icymi.title: We Call It Imagineering video series goes behind the scenes of new lands and attractions
icymi.body: A new documentary-style series inspired by Walt Disney's original Disneyland specials shows how Imagineers design future theme park experiences. The episodes cover lands, attractions, and entertainment in development.

icymi.title: Disney and Formula 1 extend partnership into 2026 race season
icymi.body: Mickey and Friends return to Formula 1 trackside experiences for the new season after debuting at the Las Vegas Grand Prix in 2025. The multi-year Fuel the Magic collaboration continues through 2026 events.

icymi.title: Light-up Sorcerer Mickey shoulder plush and mystery figure boxes arrive at Disneyland
icymi.body: New merchandise including a Fantasia-inspired plush that sits on shoulders and lights up, plus blind-box Mickey Mouse and Stitch figures, are now available across Disneyland Resort shops. The Sorcerer Mickey plush retails for thirty-five dollars.

spotlight.title: Wait times held steady entering Thanksgiving week despite Lightning Lane sellouts
spotlight.body: Average standby queues across Walt Disney World remained consistent with recent weeks as the resort moves into its busiest holiday travel period. The pattern suggests balanced crowd distribution even as three parks exhausted their skip-the-line inventory.

parkioInsight.text: Steady averages often mask hour-to-hour swings during holiday weeks. Attractions in the back of each park—like Pandora, Galaxy's Edge, and World Showcase—tend to stay lighter until 11am as guests cluster near entrances.
